paths.title: Cursor Academy
paths.tagline: Code faster and ship with confidence in the AI-first editor
paths.description: An eight-lesson path from installing Cursor and mastering Tab autocomplete to running a complete spec-to-merged-PR delivery workflow. Covers chatting with an unfamiliar codebase, precise inline edits versus coordinated multi-file changes, delegating whole tasks to Agent mode with review checkpoints, writing .cursor/rules/*.mdc files that keep the agent on your team's conventions, disciplined debugging, and running parallel background and cloud agents for bigger work.
